name: AI::CTactics::ChangeState
evidence: the monster AI transition. Opens `if (id < 0 || 0xf < id) Assert()`, refuses while the current state's GetStateID() is 0xf (DEAD), calls the outgoing state's slot 4, indexes a 16-entry array by the id in EDI, calls slot 2, and on a negative result takes states[1] (IDLE) and enters that ignoring its result. See docs/protocol/monster_ai.md

name: AI::CTactics::SetTarget
evidence: called with 0 it zeroes ten consecutive dwords at ctx+0xbc..+0xe0 and returns true; called with a target it stores it at ctx+0xbc plus the tick at ctx+0xcc, and returns whether ctx+0xbc survived the validity call. The clear/set pair over one field is what names it

name: AI::CTactics::Init
evidence: reads pRefTactics (ctx+0x2c) fields 0x18/0x1c/0x79/0x80/0x89, seeds a random +1/-1 sign into this+0x59, and ends in the only ChangeState(0) in the image -- state 0 is SPAWN, so this is what puts a fresh monster there

name: CAIState::DispatchMessage
evidence: vtable slot 36. A switch over exactly 0x21..0x2b forwarding each to vtable+0x94..+0xbc (slots 37..47), asserting on anything else. Every send site tests the result against 2

name: CAIState::OnEnter
evidence: vtable slot 2, the base. Two statements: this+0x10 = g_tickMs (DAT_00c82620) and this+0x14 = 0 -- it starts the dwell clock and clears the timeout. Derived OnEnters call it first; a negative return from an override refuses the transition

name: CAIState::OnUpdate
evidence: vtable slot 3, the base. `if (timeout != 0 && timeout < g_tickMs - enteredAt) return -1` -- the dwell expiry every derived OnUpdate tests with `if (CAIState::OnUpdate() < 0)`

name: CAIState::OnLeave
evidence: vtable slot 4, the base, a bare `return 0`. Called by ChangeState on the outgoing state before the incoming one is entered; only BATTLE, FLEE and PICKITEM override it

name: CAIState::ExtendDwell
evidence: sets this+0x14 = (g_tickMs - this+0x10) + 3000, the dwell extension CAIState::OnUpdate then tests. The same 3000 ms literal opens vtable slot 17 at 0x00559310

name: CAIState::OnMsg_0x22
evidence: vtable slot 38, reached from DispatchMessage case 0x22. Runs a range test (0x00545e50 over a distance from 0x0053d7a0) and on success ChangeState(3) -- BATTLE. Sent by EMOTION, HOMING, WANDER and WATCHOUT from their OnUpdate. The engine names none of the eleven messages anywhere in the image, so the id is the name

name: CAIState::OnMsg_0x26
evidence: vtable slot 42. ChangeState(5) -- HOMING -- then returns 2. Sent by IDLE::OnEnter and WANDER::OnUpdate

name: CAIState::OnMsg_0x28
evidence: vtable slot 44. Copies a six-field location (dword, dword, word, dword, dword, dword) out of the object at ctx+0x14c into 0x00541110, then ChangeState(1) -- IDLE. The only message handler BATTLE overrides

name: CAIState::OnMsg_0x29
evidence: vtable slot 45. Clears the target via SetTarget(0) when a float at owner+0x170 is <= 0; performs no transition, unlike the other ten

name: CAIState::OnMsg_0x2a
evidence: vtable slot 46. Branches on its byte argument: 1 goes to ChangeState(1) IDLE, 2 and 3 each check a slot-0x fc getter for the matching value and raise 0x704f

name: CAIState::OnMsg_0x2b

name: CEnchant_Reinforce::MakeAttempt
evidence: vtable slot 1. Calls slot 7 for the rate, clamps it with `if (rate < 10) rate = 10; else if (99 < rate) rate = 100`, then rolls `rand() % 100 < rate`. The floor of ten and the strictly-greater ceiling test are both literals here

name: CEnchant_Reinforce::GetSuccessRate
evidence: vtable slot 7, 41 bytes: calls slot 6 for the base, then IGObj::GetParam(0xad) through vtable offset 0x104, truncates it with the CRT's __ftol2 at 0x9fbb40, and adds. This is what names param 173 the reinforce success bonus

name: CEnchant_Reinforce::GetBaseSuccessRate
evidence: vtable slot 6. Adds a second contribution when a second element is loaded -- returning early if the first already exceeds 99 -- then adds a flat 5 when the item carries magic-option tag 0x6c75636b ('luck', MATTR_LUCK in magic_options.md) and the rate is still under 100

name: CEnchant_Reinforce::LookupPackedRate
evidence: unpacks the per-plus-level success byte: tier = clamp(n/4+1, 1, 3), within = (n < 12) ? n%4 : 3, then reads the dword at refObjItem + (tier+21)*32 and shifts right by (3-within)*8. Four rates per field, high byte first

name: CEnchant_Reinforce::CheckPreconditions
evidence: vtable slot 5. Returns 0x5406 with no source item, 0x540a when a loaded second element's kind differs from the target's, and 0x5420 when a context flag is set but the item lacks magic-option tag 0x61746861 ('atha', MATTR_ATHANASIA)

name: CEnchant_Reinforce::LoadItem
evidence: vtable slot 0. Picks slot index 0, 1 or 3 by what kind of item it was handed, returns 0x5412 if that slot is already occupied, and otherwise stores the handle at ctx+0x2242 + index*12, the pointer at +0x2246 and a flag at +0x224a

name: CEnchant::CheckPreconditions
evidence: vtable slot 4, the base every operation calls first. Returns 0x5406 when ctx+0x2246 is null, 0x5407 when ctx+0x2252 is null, and otherwise 1 or 0x5408 from a third virtual check

name: CEnchant::ReleaseLoadedItems
evidence: vtable slot 2. Walks the 12-byte-stride slot array at ctx+0x2242 releasing each loaded item; SocketMaker and SocketStoneEraser override it with their own version at 0x00504810

name: UI_REINFORCERR::ShowOutcome
evidence: decodes the reinforce outcome flag byte: 0x10 SUCCESS, 0x20 failure (low nibble 0 plain FAIL, bit 0x01 option level lost -- ZERO or DOWN by the level left, bit 0x02 durability lost), 0x40 BREAKDOWN. The bits are tested in that order and the two failure sub-bits are not exclusive

name: GInterfaceRecv::OnAlchemyResult
evidence: the alchemy result packet handler: byte result (1 success, 2 failure); on success a byte kind (1 compound cancelled, 2 reinforce) then a flag byte and a slot byte with 13 subtracted before use -- a fifth independent witness for equipment.MaxEquipSlots; on failure a uint16 0x54xx error code
